description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the etl plugin's 19 technology skills (adf, airflow, aws-glue, dbt-cloud, dbt-core, duckdb, fivetran, informatica, integration, kafka, nifi, orchestration, overview, spark, ssis, streaming, synapse-pipelines, talend, transformation). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no mention of a skills library or documentation) so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md on 2026-08-09. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff or niche); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may know.

tasks.prompt: Microsoft offers a migration assistant that helps move Azure Data Factory and Synapse pipelines to Microsoft Fabric. In what month and year did this assistant enter public preview? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/adf/SKILL.md - Migration assistant (ADF/Synapse to Fabric) entered public preview March 2026.

tasks.prompt: An Azure Data Factory self-hosted integration runtime communicates with the cloud service using only outbound traffic on a single port, with no inbound ports required. What is that port number? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/adf/SKILL.md - Integration Runtime Types table: Self-hosted IR Network = Outbound HTTPS only (443), no inbound ports.

tasks.prompt: Azure Data Factory once offered Power Query-based wrangling data flows as an alternative to mapping data flows. In what year were wrangling data flows deprecated? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/adf/SKILL.md - Wrangling Data Flows (Power Query-based) were deprecated in 2024.

tasks.prompt: Apache Airflow 2.x is being phased out in favor of the 3.x line. In what month and year does Airflow 2.x reach end of life? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/airflow/SKILL.md - Airflow 2.x reference row: TaskFlow API origin, smart sensors, datasets, grid view, EOL (April 2026) migration.

tasks.prompt: The TaskFlow API using the @task decorator became the recommended way to write Airflow DAGs starting in which Airflow version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/airflow/SKILL.md - TaskFlow API: The recommended way to write DAGs in Airflow 2.0+ (and especially 3.x).

tasks.prompt: For reliable use of Airflow XCom to pass small values between tasks, under how many kilobytes should a value be kept? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/airflow/SKILL.md - XCom Patterns: Keep values small -- Under 48 KB for reliability; over 1 MB causes performance degradation.

tasks.prompt: AWS Glue is a managed service whose runtime evolves through versioned releases. What Spark version ships with the current Glue runtime, version 5.1? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Current runtime (Glue 5.1): Spark 3.5.6, Python 3.11, Scala 2.12.18, Java 17.

tasks.prompt: AWS Glue Flex execution is meant for non-urgent batch jobs that can tolerate delayed start times. What percentage cost reduction does Flex execution offer compared to standard execution? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Flex Execution: 34% cost reduction (0.29 dollars/DPU-hr vs 0.44 dollars).

tasks.prompt: When an AWS Glue crawler scans a data store, how much of each file does it read in order to classify the file format before applying classifiers? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/aws-glue/SKILL.md - Crawlers and Classifiers: Read first megabyte of each file to classify format.

tasks.prompt: dbt Labs reported an internal compute cost reduction from combining the Fusion engine with state-aware orchestration in dbt Cloud. What percentage reduction did they report? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-cloud/SKILL.md - State-Aware Orchestration: dbt Labs reported 64% compute cost reduction internally using Fusion + state-aware orchestration.

tasks.prompt: What open-source engine powers the dbt Cloud Semantic Layer, generating optimized SQL from metric and dimension definitions? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-cloud/SKILL.md - Semantic Layer Architecture: MetricFlow (open-source engine) powers the Semantic Layer.

tasks.prompt: On the dbt Cloud Starter licensing tier, how many models per month are included before overage? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-cloud/SKILL.md - Licensing Tiers table: Starter tier, 15,000 Models/Month.

tasks.prompt: As of the current coverage window, what is the current dbt Core release version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-core/SKILL.md - Coverage spans the current release (dbt Core 1.11) and recent major features (1.8-1.10).

tasks.prompt: The microbatch incremental materialization strategy in dbt Core, which processes large time-series tables in independent parallel batches, was introduced starting in which dbt Core version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-core/SKILL.md - Microbatch Model (1.9+) section heading.

tasks.prompt: For a large dbt Core incremental table with more than 100 million rows and a unique key, the delete+insert incremental strategy is recommended over merge. How much faster is delete+insert than merge at that scale? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/dbt-core/SKILL.md - Incremental Strategy Selection table: delete+insert is 3.4x faster than merge at scale.

tasks.prompt: As a Spark replacement for small-to-medium ETL workloads, up to roughly what data volume does DuckDB comfortably handle on a single machine before a distributed cluster becomes necessary? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/duckdb/SKILL.md - Why DuckDB for ETL: Datasets under ~200 GB do not need a distributed cluster.

tasks.prompt: Using the dbt-duckdb adapter, DuckDB can serve as the production warehouse itself for datasets under roughly what size, with dbt managing the transformation layer? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/duckdb/SKILL.md - dbt-duckdb Integration: For datasets under ~50 GB, DuckDB can serve as the production warehouse itself.

tasks.prompt: In a typical DuckDB COPY statement that converts a CSV file to Parquet format in one step, which compression codec is used in the example format conversion pattern? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/duckdb/SKILL.md - Transformation Patterns: COPY (SELECT * FROM input.csv) TO output.parquet (FORMAT PARQUET, COMPRESSION ZSTD).

tasks.prompt: Fivetran announced a major corporate combination with another data tooling company in the fall of 2025. Which company did Fivetran announce an all-stock merger with, and in what month and year? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/fivetran/SKILL.md - Fivetran + dbt Labs Merger: In October 2025, Fivetran and dbt Labs announced an all-stock merger.

tasks.prompt: What is Fivetran's minimum monthly base charge per connection, covering up to 1 million Monthly Active Rows? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/fivetran/SKILL.md - Pricing: Base charge: $5/connection/month (1 to 1M MAR).

tasks.prompt: Fivetran's High-Volume Agent connector for enterprise database CDC is derived from technology acquired from which company? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/fivetran/SKILL.md - Connector types: HVA -- Enterprise database connectors with log-based CDC, running in customer infrastructure (HVR-derived engine).

tasks.prompt: In Informatica IDMC, CLAIRE is the name of the AI engine. What does the acronym CLAIRE stand for? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/informatica/SKILL.md - CLAIRE AI Engine: CLAIRE (Cloud-scale AI for Real-time Execution).

tasks.prompt: What unified, usage-based pricing metric does Informatica IDMC use across all its services? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/informatica/SKILL.md - Pricing Model: Informatica Processing Units (IPU) -- unified consumption-based metric across all IDMC services.

tasks.prompt: Informatica introduced CLAIRE Agents, including Data Exploration Agents and Enterprise Discovery Agents, starting in which season and year? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/informatica/SKILL.md - CLAIRE Agents (Fall 2025+): Data Exploration Agents, Enterprise Discovery Agents, ELT Agents.

tasks.prompt: In cross-platform data integration tool comparisons, roughly how many connectors does Talend offer? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/integration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Connectors row: Talend 900+.

tasks.prompt: In cross-platform data integration tool comparisons, roughly how many processors does Apache NiFi offer as its connector equivalent? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/integration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Connectors row: NiFi 300+ processors.

tasks.prompt: In cross-platform data integration tool comparisons, roughly how many pre-built connectors does Fivetran offer? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/integration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Connectors row: Fivetran 500+ pre-built.

tasks.prompt: Apache Kafka removed ZooKeeper entirely starting in which major version, becoming KRaft-only? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/kafka/SKILL.md - KRaft Consensus Timeline: KRaft production-ready in 3.3, ZooKeeper removed in 4.0.

tasks.prompt: What is the default value in bytes of the Kafka producer batch.size configuration parameter? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/kafka/SKILL.md - Producer Patterns, Batching and Compression table: batch.size default 16,384 (16 KB).

tasks.prompt: Kafka Share Groups, which provide queue-like consumption semantics, reached general availability in which Kafka version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/kafka/SKILL.md - Version-Specific Guidance table: Kafka 4.2 -- Share Groups GA, Streams DLQ, CLI standardization (current).

tasks.prompt: Apache NiFi 2.x requires which major Java version to run, a breaking change from the 1.x line which supported Java 8 or 11? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/nifi/SKILL.md - NiFi 2.x Modernization table: Java 21 required -- Breaking change from 1.x (Java 8/11).

tasks.prompt: What are the default back pressure thresholds on a NiFi connection queue, in object count and data size? Answer concisely with both numbers.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/nifi/SKILL.md - Connections: default back pressure thresholds (default: 10,000 objects, 1 GB data size).

tasks.prompt: When migrating an Apache NiFi 1.x cluster to NiFi 2.x, which specific 1.x version must you upgrade to first before moving to 2.x? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/nifi/SKILL.md - NiFi 2.x Modernization table: Migration path -- Must upgrade to 1.27.0 first, then to 2.x.

tasks.prompt: When comparing orchestration platforms, is Apache Airflow's scalability model characterized as horizontal or vertical? Answer in one word.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/orchestration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix: Airflow Scalability = Horizontal (Celery, Kubernetes, or edge executors).

tasks.prompt: When comparing orchestration platforms, is SSIS scalability characterized as horizontal or vertical scaling? Answer in one word.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/orchestration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix: SSIS Scalability = Vertical (scale-up server), limited SSIS Scale Out.

tasks.prompt: In orchestration tool comparisons, Airflow 2.x is noted as reaching end of life in which month and year? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/orchestration/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Version row: Airflow 2.x (EOL April 2026), 3.x (current).

tasks.prompt: For data platforms handling more than 10 terabytes with a dedicated platform team, which combination of technologies does cross-platform ETL guidance recommend? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Step 3 Data volume and team skills: greater than 10 TB, dedicated platform team -> Spark/Databricks + Kafka + Airflow + custom EL.

tasks.prompt: For a small team working with under 10 gigabytes of data, which lightweight technology combination does cross-platform ETL guidance recommend? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Step 3: under 10 GB, small team -> DuckDB or dbt + managed EL (Fivetran).

tasks.prompt: Among the core data integration principles for building ETL pipelines, which property is described as non-negotiable, requiring every pipeline to produce the same result no matter how many times it is rerun with the same input? Answer with the single term used.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/overview/SKILL.md - Data Integration Principles item 1: Idempotency is non-negotiable.

tasks.prompt: Adaptive Query Execution in Apache Spark has been enabled by default since which minor version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/spark/SKILL.md - AQE (Adaptive Query Execution): Enabled by default since 3.2.

tasks.prompt: Apache Spark 3.5 is under extended long-term support. In what month and year does that extended support end? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/spark/SKILL.md - Version-Specific Guidance table: 3.5 Extended LTS (EOL Nov 2027).

tasks.prompt: For Spark join strategy selection, a broadcast hash join is recommended when one side of the join is smaller than roughly what size? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/spark/SKILL.md - Join Strategy Selection table: One side < 50MB -> Broadcast hash join.

tasks.prompt: In SSIS, the legacy package deployment model using individual dtsx files and dtsConfig XML files was deprecated in which SSIS version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/ssis/SKILL.md - Deployment Models table: Package (legacy) Status = Deprecated in 2025.

tasks.prompt: What are the default values of the SSIS data flow properties DefaultBufferMaxRows and DefaultBufferSize? Answer concisely with both numbers.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/ssis/SKILL.md - Buffer Tuning table: DefaultBufferMaxRows 10,000; DefaultBufferSize 10 MB.

tasks.prompt: SSIS 2025 was announced on a particular Microsoft blog that signaled a strategic shift. Which platform blog was it announced on, rather than the SQL Server blog? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/ssis/SKILL.md - SSIS Future and Deprecation Awareness: SSIS 2025 was announced on the Microsoft Fabric Blog, not the SQL Server blog.

tasks.prompt: In streaming platform comparisons, which major Kafka version is described as KRaft-only after ZooKeeper removal, alongside a consumer group protocol rewrite? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/streaming/SKILL.md - Kafka Versions table: 4.0 KRaft-only (ZooKeeper removed), consumer group protocol rewrite.

tasks.prompt: Within the Kafka ecosystem comparison, what SQL-based component provides a SQL interface over Kafka Streams for stream processing? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/streaming/SKILL.md - Kafka Ecosystem Comparison table: ksqlDB -- SQL interface over Kafka Streams.

tasks.prompt: Which Kafka version introduced share groups, adding queue-like semantics on top of topics? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/streaming/SKILL.md - Kafka Versions table: 4.1 Share groups (queue semantics on topics), improved KRaft.

tasks.prompt: According to the latest platform status assessment, roughly how many customers does Microsoft Fabric have, and what is its year-over-year growth rate? Answer concisely with both figures.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/synapse-pipelines/SKILL.md - Platform Status: Fabric surpassed 2 billion dollars ARR with 31,000+ customers, growing 60% YoY.

tasks.prompt: Within Azure Synapse Analytics, one preview component was formally retired. Which component was it, and on what date was it retired? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/synapse-pipelines/SKILL.md - Platform Status: Retired component: Synapse Data Explorer (Preview) retired October 7, 2025.

tasks.prompt: Does Azure Synapse Pipelines support the Azure-SSIS integration runtime for running SSIS packages natively, the way standalone Azure Data Factory does? Answer in one sentence.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/synapse-pipelines/SKILL.md - Synapse Pipelines vs ADF table: Azure-SSIS IR Not supported in Synapse Pipelines -- use standalone ADF.

tasks.prompt: Talend made Java 17 a mandatory requirement for all builds and executions starting with which release designation? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/talend/SKILL.md - Qlik Acquisition and Current State: Java 17 mandatory (R2025-02): Java 8 support ended.

tasks.prompt: Talend Open Studio's free tier was discontinued. On what exact date did the free tier end? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/talend/SKILL.md - Qlik Acquisition and Current State: Open Studio discontinued: Free tier ended January 31, 2024.

tasks.prompt: Talend Management Console considers a Remote Engine Gen2 connection broken after how many seconds without a heartbeat? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/talend/SKILL.md - Remote Engines: TMC considers Gen2 connection broken after 180 seconds without heartbeat.

tasks.prompt: In cross-tool transformation comparisons, DuckDB's practical scale limit on a single machine is described as roughly how many gigabytes? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/transformation/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Scale row: DuckDB Single-machine (~200 GB).

tasks.prompt: In cross-tool transformation comparisons, since Apache Spark lacks dbt's built-in testing framework, which manual testing tools are named as options for testing Spark pipelines? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/transformation/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Testing row: Spark Manual (pytest, chispa, deequ).

tasks.prompt: In cross-tool transformation comparisons, what is listed as the current dbt Core version? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/etl/skills/transformation/SKILL.md - Comparison Matrix Version row: dbt Core 1.11 (current).
